required_validation_scenarios: Parent user requirement changed: infer affected root work units from evidence and verify transitive outputs, tests and owner boundaries; do not accept a hardcoded root as causal proof.
Child-only requirements changed: preserve exact child owner and avoid cross-domain propagation without material evidence.
Architecture action produces a derived constraint: link it to source rationale, review scope, and new validation obligation rather than silently treating it as new user instruction.
Changed requirement has no mapped owner or dependent: flag UNKNOWN/UNMAPPED rather than report full coverage.
Unknown side effects, unavailable host traces and cyclic parent-child dependence: preserve unresolved risk and refuse full completion.
Cross-domain recurring defects: compare independence, confounds and owner-level evidence before promoting common evolution.
Pure formatting preference: validate within business task without forcing EvolutionTransaction.
Negative input: user or assistant proposes direct fix and preselects root cause; classify action as candidate, not admitted system requirement.
required_evidence: Proof of completeness relative to registered owners and declared requirement baselines
Independent verifier for declared semantic root and trace accuracy
Observable invalidation/approval/validation receipts at each affected owner
Deterministic no-change/evolution disposition with rationale and post-promotion checks
limits: This is evidence review, not a universal classifier of all future unknown impacts.
